tidbit: Did you know… about 9,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
SpaceX is securing $40 billion in debt to fund artificial intelligence chip purchases, according to Business Today Confirmed. The company cited Starlink revenue and investment-grade status.
SoftBank is reportedly planning a $50 billion technology investment in Malaysia, positioning the country as an aspiring artificial intelligence nation, per CNBC Reported.
A 12-year-old has won a top youth prize at an Australian Poetry Slam with a piece titled Dear ChatGPT, according to The Guardian Reported.
Anthropic's $750 billion compute costs are threatening profitability, per Ticker News Reported.
Elvis Presley IP owners are suing Anthropic over allegations of copyright infringement, according to Digital Music News Reported.
Free every hour.
